tagline: Private invite-only group video meetings, text chat and photo sharing
platform: Web app (Node + Socket.IO, port 4444), deployed on DigitalOcean
summary: The most mature project: it's deployed, with an automated server setup (Caddy HTTPS, coturn TURN, firewall, nightly backups) and 21 commits of steady iteration. Accounts are invite-only with scrypt passwords and an admin console. Video is a peer-to-peer WebRTC mesh with unusually good diagnostics (mic level bars, a "no audio received" label, autoplay recovery). Chat supports photos, editing and deleting. Compared with Jitsi or Discord, it lacks screen sharing, multiple rooms, DMs and notifications, and the mesh limits calls to about 6 people.

items: Invite-only email and password accounts, with scrypt hashes
30-day signed-cookie sessions. A password change signs that person out everywhere
Profile: name, unique private email, avatar, password change
Admin console in a VS Code-style layout: user table with search and sorting by any column
Add user (generated password shown once), reset password, suspend and delete (optionally with all their content)
Admin command line: create, reset-password, list
Group video over a WebRTC mesh, with TURN relay support
Join explicitly, with mic and camera toggles and a Leave button
Joins with whatever devices work, and a red notice explains what's blocked
Your own mic level (green), incoming audio level per person (blue), and a "No audio received" label
"Click to turn on sound" when the browser blocks autoplay
Text chat (last 500 messages) with clickable links
Multiline composer: Enter sends on desktop, the send button on touch screens
Photo upload (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, up to 20 MB) with captions
In-app photo viewer, and downloads that keep the original filename
Edit and delete your own messages, live for everyone, marked (edited)
Who's in the app, and who's in the call
setup.sh: Docker, Caddy HTTPS, coturn, ufw, nightly backups, first admin from ADMIN_EMAIL
RESET=1 starts over, with a backup taken first
channel4444-update and logs commands
Cache-busting with content hashes, so a deploy only needs a normal reload
Pending writes flushed when the server stops

risks: No automated tests on a production app with auth and admin powers
server.js is 774 lines in one file. Split it into routes before adding rooms or DMs
'setup copy.sh' is committed to the repo by mistake
Data is stored as files in data/, so there's no transactional database. Fine for a small group
Password reset depends on an admin, because there's no email
